title: Greet someone in Portuguese
detail: Tudo bem? + full exchange with a Portuguese speaker, online or in person.

title: Introduce yourself
detail: Name, where you're from, one thing about you — out loud, no notes.

title: Order a bica and a pastel de nata
detail: Full order in Portuguese only — 'Uma bica e um pastel de nata, se faz favor.'

title: Ask the price of something
detail: Quanto custa isto? in a real or simulated shop, and understand the answer.

title: Count your party
detail: Answer 'Mesa para quantos?' correctly in a restaurant scenario.

title: Direct a driver
detail: Destination + 'Quanto tempo demora?' in a taxi/TVDE scenario.

title: Ask someone to slow down
detail: Use 'Pode falar mais devagar?' or 'Pode repetir?' in a real conversation.

title: Weekend small talk
detail: Ask a Portuguese speaker 'O que é que fizeste no fim de semana?' and share yours.

title: Talk about your Portugal plans
detail: Vou + infinitive — tell someone where you're going to go.

title: Fado listening rep
detail: Listen to one fado song (try Amália Rodrigues); write down 5 words you recognized.

title: Book an appointment by phone
detail: Simulated or real: 'Queria marcar...' + name + time.

title: Describe a symptom
detail: Tenho dores de... at a farmácia or to a friend.

title: Use 'já' and 'ainda não'
detail: Answer a 'já experimentaste...?' question naturally in conversation.

title: Talk about your job
detail: O que é que fazes? — 3+ sentences about your real work.

title: Tell a past-tense story
detail: What you did last weekend, 5+ preterite verbs, no notes.

title: Ask for a discount
detail: 'Faz algum desconto?' / 'Faz-me por cinco?' at a market — mercado style.

title: Invite someone out
detail: 'Queres sair...?' + handle a schedule change gracefully.

title: Give a recommendation
detail: 'Conheço um sítio perfeito' — recommend a tasca, café or miradouro to someone.

title: Handle a money situation
detail: Multibanco, exchange, or MB Way conversation — know the vocabulary cold.

title: Record a 1-minute video
detail: Introduce yourself on camera in Portuguese. Watch it. Cringe. Improve.

title: Hold a 5-minute casual conversation
detail: Slang included — fixe, pá, pois. With a Portuguese speaker or the AI chat.

title: Use tu forms naturally
detail: Hold a conversation entirely in informal tu — falas, queres, achas.

title: Give a real opinion
detail: Acho que... about football (a seleção!), music, or food — and defend it.

title: Invite a Portuguese speaker out
detail: Vamos + specific place and time. Real invitation, real answer.

title: Tell a 'tava-a story
detail: 'Eu 'tava... quando...' — set a scene and deliver the punchline.

title: Meet someone's family
detail: O senhor / a senhora + faz-questão politeness at a dinner or video call.

title: Use the subjunctive
detail: 'Espero que...' or 'Tomara que...' correctly in conversation.

title: Voice message in Portuguese
detail: Send a real WhatsApp voice message in Portuguese (casual OK).

title: Discuss fado or telenovelas
detail: Recommend and receive a recommendation — Amália counts.

title: Watch a telenovela episode, 80%+
detail: Portuguese audio, PT subtitles max. Rate honestly in the tracker.
